faqs.a: No. You keep Zenoti and the workflows your team already uses. Prestique's agent is a separate, custom-built product that works with Zenoti rather than replacing it.

The agent only does what Zenoti's API allows and what you have approved. For example, Zenoti provides an API to retrieve available slots for a service booking, and endpoints to mark an appointment as confirmed or undo confirmation. Anything outside that scope goes to your team. API access can also depend on your Zenoti plan or how your setup is configured.
faqs.q: What can the agent actually do inside Zenoti?

faqs.a: Anything the agent shouldn't handle goes to your team with a summary of the call, so your staff have the context they need to follow up.
faqs.q: What happens when the agent reaches something it can't handle?

faqs.a: Every call is recorded with a transcript and a summary of what the caller needed, so you have a full record of each conversation.
faqs.q: How do I know what the agent said on each call?

faqs.a: The free audit takes about five minutes and shows where an AI agent would help your business first. You can also book a call with Prestique to talk through your setup.
Prestique is not affiliated with Zenoti. Zenoti is a trademark of its owner. Prestique builds custom AI voice and text agents for small businesses.

headline: A custom AI receptionist that works with Zenoti — built and controlled by you.

howItWorks.body: The agent picks up after hours and when the line is busy. Every call is recorded with a transcript and a summary of what the caller needed. Anything the agent shouldn't handle goes straight to your team.
howItWorks.title: The agent answers when your team can't

howItWorks.body: Where Zenoti's API allows it, Prestique connects the agent so it works from the same information your team sees. For example, Zenoti provides an API to retrieve available slots for a service booking, so the agent can check availability using that. API access can depend on your Zenoti plan or how your setup is configured.
howItWorks.title: It connects to Zenoti's API

howItWorks.body: You decide what the agent says and does. Changes are made when you ask for them. The agent can also follow up with a caller by text message after a call. Nothing is set up without your approval, and the agent only acts within what Zenoti's API allows and what you have signed off on.
howItWorks.title: You stay in control

intro: When your team is busy or the salon is closed, calls still come in. Prestique builds a custom AI agent that answers those calls, checks what Zenoti's API makes available, and passes anything else to your team with a summary of what the caller needed.

You keep Zenoti and everything your team already knows. The agent connects to Zenoti where the API allows — which can depend on your Zenoti plan or how your setup is configured — and works from the same information your team sees.
